description: Meme built from a photograph of two computer monitors placed side by side. The left screen shows a Washington Post article map of the estimated percentage of undocumented immigrants by area (data credited to Pew Research); the right screen shows the New York Times interactive 2016 election precinct-level voting map. A bold caption across the top claims 'the map where illegal immigrants live perfectly overlaps the blue counties where Democrats vote.'

Screenshot of Q drop #2176, posted Sep 15 2018 by tripcode Q !!mG7VJxZNCl. The drop links to the GPO-hosted PDF of Executive Order 13526 and quotes Section 1.7, 'Classification Prohibitions and Limitations,' listing the four purposes for which information may not be classified or kept classified.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCl No.239. Sep 15 2018 19:55:33 (EST). https://www.gpo.gov/fdsys/pkg/CFR-2010-title3-vol1/pdf/CFR-2010-title3-vol1-eo13526.pdf CFR-2010-title3-vol1/pdf/CFR-2010-title3-vol1-eo13526.pdf" target="_new" title="archive" id="archive_today">. Executive Order 13526. Sec 1.7. "Classification Prohibitions and Limitations. (a) In no case shall information be classified, continue to be maintained as classified, or fail to be declassified in order to:. (1) conceal violations of law, inefficiency, or administrative error;. (2) prevent embarrassment to a person, organization, or agency;. (3) restrain competition; or. (4) prevent or delay the release of information that does not require protection in the interest of the national security.". Q. 2176
